notes.title: DEMO ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
BASIC INFORMATION

During the development of the game, a free demo version will be available to any user. There will be 7 days in the main game, each of which represents one or another experience or mental upheaval. The first two days are an exceptional introduction of the player to the situation in the inner and social world of the protagonist. Therefore, these two days will be more representative in order to demonstrate to the user the main ways to show the plot or Nikolai's psychological problems. 

Current game development process
We are currently working on a trailer for the demo and on the demo itself. On our discord server eats all the accurate information about the development process and all sorts of insiders.
